title: cortusa matthioli subsp. pekinensis
intro: Cortusa matthioli subsp. pekinensis, commonly known as Chinese hare's ear, is a type of flowering plant in the gentian family. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Chinese hare's ear include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and edema. The bioactive constituents of Cortusa matthioli subsp. pekinensis include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
